# Jai Khyapa Parampara

> Jai Khyapa Parampara is a free spiritual knowledge website focused on Kali, Kalabhairava, Khyapa Parampara teachings, sacred texts, sahasranamas, devotional articles, audio, and related spiritual resources.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/): Main temple of knowledge, sacred resources, and site introduction.
- [About the Parampara](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/about/): The lineage, Param Guru Bama Khyapa, Gurubaba Shyama Khyapa, and Shri Praveen Radhakrishnan.
- [Free Ebooks](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/ebooks/): Free Adya Mahakali and Kalabhairava sahasranama PDFs in English and Hindi, plus the 108 names.
- [Topics](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/topics/): The eight curated topic paths through the archive.
- [Articles](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/articles/): Full article archive with topic hubs and A-Z browsing.
- [Core Entities Glossary](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/glossary/): Canonical definitions for recurring deities, teachers, places, and lineage terms.
- [All Keywords](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/tags/): Keyword index for navigation; tag pages are noindex and not in the sitemap.
- [Gallery](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/gallery/): Sacred art gallery for Kali, Bhairava, Kalika, Shmashana Kali, and related devotional forms.
- [Search](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/search/): On-site article search for readers.

## Core Topics

- Khyapa Parampara
- Param Guru Bama Khyapa
- Gurubaba Shyama Khyapa
- Shri Praveen Radhakrishnan and the Kaliputra Mission
- Ma Kali and Ma Adya Mahakali
- Bhairava and Kalabhairava
- Tantra, mantra, sadhana, and devotional practice
- Sacred texts, sahasranamas, stotrams, and kavachams
- Tarapith, Kamakhya, Shantikunj, and sacred pilgrimage places
